### `dsp_frx_cos_bhaskara_I`

_Source: `lib/dsp_frx/dsp_frx.h`_

```cpp
float dsp_frx_cos_bhaskara_I(float x);
```

Fast cosine approximation based on Bhaskara I algorithm.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `x` | Wrapped or unwrapped phase. |

**Returns:** Cosine approximation.

> **Note:** ONLY USE POSITIVE ANGLES!
